breakdown.description: Prandtl number value is inconsistent with the stated fluid (air at 25 C does not have Pr≈7).
breakdown.reason: The Agent accepted Pr = 7.0 for air at 25°C without correction or comment. It directly used this incorrect value in the Dittus-Boelter correlation. The ground truth requires either correcting Pr to ~0.7 for air or identifying that Pr = 7.0 corresponds to a different fluid (water/oil). The Agent failed to flag or resolve this inconsistency.
